newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde April 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde April 29.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- Voters remain skeptical and rather indifferent about the upcoming parliamentary election: One-third say they no longer expect anything from either the Left or the Right, a Le Monde-Sofres poll shows.

-- -- Financial markets regulator COB asks firm managers to improve quality of information provided to investors, forbids denials of news reports disclosing true facts, saying firms will have to stick to a "no comment" in such cases. It also calls for a simplification of accounting rules.
-- France is undergoing its deepest drought in fifty years.
-- Insurer GAN posts a loss of 5.7 billion francs for 1997, partly due to real-estate exposure.
-- French oil companies oppose new European regulations designed to cut air pollution.
